p: This day is the completion of the cycle
of the days of the Chag,
on which we were beseeching and praying
and this day is called Hoshana Rabbah,
because a great outcry arises in the heart
to be saved with a great salvation,
that we have not yet been saved.
וְהוּא אוּשְׁפִּיזָא דְּדָוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם,
And it is the Ushpiza of Dovid HaMelech, peace be upon him,
a great outcry in his heart,
because it always seemed in his eyes
that he was still standing outside.
As is brought in the Midrash (Midrash Tehillim 16:11)
"I have chosen to sit at the threshold":
the day of the beating of the aravah,
the two thighs, Netzach and Hod,
as is known from the holy Zohar;
and there the damage from the accuser took place,
"And he saw that he could not prevail against him,
and he touched the hollow of his thigh."
כִּי בְּיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם בְּעַצְמוֹ,
For over Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him, himself,
who is the very body of Tiferes,
he had no dominion at all;
that is, over the prophets and prophetesses
who would come forth from him in later generations,
as is brought in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah 77:3).
For the damage and the flaw
and this is as it says (ibid.),
"and the hollow of Yaakov's thigh was dislocated" —
meaning that he moved them away from the body,
which is the aspect of truth,
so that they would have some leaning to the side,
away from the aspect of the point of truth.
As we find with the false prophets,
that they certainly did not invent from their own hearts
but they imagined in their souls
that it was the spirit of Hashem stirring within them;
לְמִיכָיְהוּ בֶּן יִמְלָא (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים ב יח, כג)
to Michayhu ben Yimla (Divrei HaYamim II 18:23),
"Which way did the spirit of Hashem pass
a likeness of the illumination of Hashem's spirit,
וּכְמוֹ כֵן הוּא הַפְּגָם בְּכָל הַדּוֹרוֹת
And so too is the flaw in all the generations:
in that there are imaginings in this
that lean away from the point of truth.
And the remedy is alluded to immediately
in the holy Torah, in the verse (Bereishis 32:32),
וּכְאָמְרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה עח, ה)
and as our Sages of blessed memory said (Bereishis Rabbah 78:5),
for Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
meaning that He made shine upon him
the aspect of the point of truth
for the sake of the remedy.
And this flaw is chiefly repaired
through the beating of the aravah,
which is the sweetening of the five Gevuros
עַל יְדֵי מִילּוּי יוּ״ד הֵ״א וָא״ו
through the spelled-out letters Yud Hei Vav
whose numerical value is tal, thirty-nine,
which corresponds to the rectification of
that were in the work of the Mishkan.
is the aspect of the shining of the sun
upon the aspect of the final Hei,
which is the recipient of the flow of bounty.
And also the holy Name M"H,
spelled out with Alefs, as mentioned above,
is the root of the rectification, as is known.
Now, on this day we read in the Torah
"on the sixth day" and "on the seventh day,"
which alludes to the joining of Yesod and Malchus,
מִפְּנֵי שֶׁבַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה הוּא גַּם כֵּן
because on this day is also
the main rectification of the flaw of the covenant,
שֶׁיֵּשׁ גַּם כֵּן עַל זֶה קִטְרוּג
regarding which there is also an accusation
from the heavenly prince of Esav
as we said regarding this on the Ushpiza of Yosef,
שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ לֹא טַעַם וְלֹא רֵיחַ,
which has neither taste nor fragrance,
alludes to the aspect of Yosef HaTzaddik;
for even one who has in him
no Torah or mitzvah at all
will be called by the name tzaddik.
And concerning this there is a great accusation,
with the claim that even Israel,
who are called by the name tzaddikim,
are not clean of this flaw;
וּכְאָמְרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (מִדְרַשׁ תַּנְחוּמָא כִּי תֵצֵא י)
as our Sages of blessed memory said (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Seitzei 10)
who is the root of the kelipos of Esav,
that he would throw the cut foreskins heavenward
and say, "Take for Yourself what You have chosen."
that the mitzvah of milah which Israel fulfills
in the holiness of the covenant,
And to this as well alludes
the day of the beating of the aravah:
in its spelled-out form whose value is tal, thirty-nine,
which alludes to the rectification of the first flaw
who was cursed with thirty-nine curses,
for what he begot during the hundred and thirty years.
And the main rectification of this flaw
הוּא עַל יְדֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
by which one merits the "dew of Torah,"
as our Sages of blessed memory said (Kesubos 111b)
"For a dew of lights is Your dew":
And as our Sages of blessed memory said (Kiddushin 30b),
drag him to the beis midrash";
and the "repulsive one" is the desire in this matter,
which is called repulsive and loathsome.
הַיְינוּ עַל יְדֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
that is, through Torah she'b'al peh,
which is called the beis midrash,
one is able to subdue it.
